nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the small enums shared across the consolidation engine: ConsolidationTrigger (Idle/Lazy/Forced/Manual) and CandidateMode (Embedding/Manifest), each with a string round-trip.

nodes.name: auto.rs
nodes.summary: AutoEmbeddingProvider resolves and caches the best available embedding backend (local, OpenAI, or Azure) based on integrations config and agent type, then delegates embed/embed_batch calls to it.
nodes.languageNotes: Caches the resolved provider behind a tokio::sync::Mutex so repeated embed calls avoid re-resolving configuration.

nodes.name: azure.rs
nodes.summary: AzureEmbeddingProvider implements the EmbeddingProvider trait by calling the Azure OpenAI embeddings REST endpoint via reqwest.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the EmbeddingProvider trait and EmbeddingResult struct shared by all embedding backends, plus a cosine_similarity utility used for vector search, and re-exports the auto/azure/openai submodules.

nodes.name: openai.rs
nodes.summary: OpenAIEmbeddingProvider implements the EmbeddingProvider trait by calling the OpenAI embeddings REST endpoint via reqwest.

nodes.name: crud.rs
nodes.summary: Base read/write operations on the learnings SQLite table: insert_learning, load_active_learnings, load_learning_by_id, a row-to-struct mapper, and content-hash-based dedup (Reinforced vs Novel).

nodes.name: lifecycle.rs
nodes.summary: Status-transition API for learnings and consolidation runs: loading pending/active candidates, promoting, merging, abandoning, touch-recall bookkeeping, deprecating/reactivating, editing, deleting, and writing consolidation_runs ledger rows.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the L3 learnings store documenting its table schema and layout, exposing scope_for_agent(agent_id) and re-exporting crud/lifecycle/prompt/ranking/schema/stats/types plus shared test setup helpers.

nodes.name: prompt.rs
nodes.summary: Renders ranked learnings into the agent system prompt: freshness/reinforcement badges, per-line caps, the main format_learnings_for_prompt formatter, and inject_learnings_into_prompt which drives embedding-based recall and schedules a background touch_recall.

nodes.name: ConsolidationTrigger
nodes.summary: Enum identifying why a consolidation run fired: Idle, Lazy, Forced, or Manual, with an as_str round-trip.

nodes.name: CandidateMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting the candidate-recall strategy for a batch: Embedding (vector search) or Manifest (salience ranking).

nodes.name: AutoEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation that lazily resolves and caches the best available backend (local/OpenAI/Azure) based on config and agent type.

nodes.name: AzureEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation backed by the Azure OpenAI embeddings REST API.

nodes.name: cosine_similarity
nodes.summary: Computes the cosine similarity between two embedding vectors, used to rank candidate learnings/memories by relevance.

nodes.name: EmbeddingResult
nodes.summary: Return value of an embedding call: the vector, its dimensionality, and the model used to produce it.

nodes.name: EmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by every embedding backend (auto/openai/azure), exposing embed, embed_batch, dimensions, and provider_name.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation backed by the OpenAI embeddings REST API.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbedRequest
nodes.summary: Request body shape for the OpenAI embeddings endpoint.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbedResponse
nodes.summary: Top-level response shape returned by the OpenAI embeddings endpoint.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbedData
nodes.summary: A single embedding vector entry within an OpenAI embeddings response.

nodes.name: insert_learning
nodes.summary: Inserts a new learning row into the learnings table, generating an ID and timestamps when not already set.

nodes.name: load_active_learnings
nodes.summary: Loads all learnings with status=active for a given agent scope.

nodes.name: load_learning_by_id
nodes.summary: Loads a single learning row by its primary key ID.

nodes.name: row_to_learning
nodes.summary: Maps a SQLite row into a Learning struct, deserializing enum and optional columns.

nodes.name: content_hash_dedup
nodes.summary: Checks whether a new learning's content hash already exists for the scope/category and either reinforces the existing row or signals a novel insert.

nodes.name: DedupResult
nodes.summary: Enum result of content-hash dedup: Reinforced (matched an existing learning) or Novel (no match, safe to insert).

nodes.name: load_pending_learnings
nodes.summary: Loads all learnings with status=pending for a scope, awaiting consolidation.

nodes.name: load_active_candidates
nodes.summary: Loads active learnings for a scope to serve as consolidation-decision candidates.

nodes.name: count_pending_learnings
nodes.summary: Counts pending learnings across all scopes.

nodes.name: count_pending_for_scope
nodes.summary: Counts pending learnings for a specific agent scope.

nodes.name: last_consolidation_at
nodes.summary: Reads the timestamp of the most recent consolidation run for a scope.

nodes.name: promote_pending_to_active
nodes.summary: Transitions a pending learning to active status after an Add decision.

nodes.name: mark_merged
nodes.summary: Marks a pending learning as merged into an existing active learning after an Update decision.

nodes.name: abandon_pending
nodes.summary: Marks a pending learning as abandoned, used on Delete/None decisions or consolidation failure.

nodes.name: touch_recall
nodes.summary: Updates a learning's last-recalled timestamp and reinforcement count after it is surfaced in a prompt.

nodes.name: record_consolidation_run
nodes.summary: Writes a consolidation_runs ledger row summarizing counts, trigger, mode, and timing for a completed run.

nodes.name: deprecate_learning
nodes.summary: Marks an active learning as deprecated so it stops being surfaced.

nodes.name: reactivate_learning
nodes.summary: Restores a deprecated/merged learning back to active status.

nodes.name: update_learning_body
nodes.summary: Edits a learning's takeaway/content, recomputing its content hash to keep dedup consistent.

nodes.name: delete_learning
nodes.summary: Hard-deletes a learning row from the table.

nodes.name: ConsolidationRunRecord
nodes.summary: Full record of a consolidation run's scope, account, trigger, mode, counts, error, and timing, written to the consolidation_runs ledger.

nodes.name: scope_for_agent
nodes.summary: Maps an agent_id to its memory scope string used to partition learnings in the shared table.

nodes.name: enforce_caps
nodes.summary: Truncates a learning's text to stay within prompt-injection length/line caps.

nodes.name: format_learnings_for_prompt
nodes.summary: Renders a ranked list of learnings into the markdown block injected into the agent system prompt, applying freshness/reinforcement badges and caps.

nodes.name: learning_prompt_revision
nodes.summary: Computes a revision/version marker for a scope's learnings prompt block so callers can detect when it changes.

nodes.name: inject_learnings_into_prompt
nodes.summary: Main entry point that embeds the query, ranks/searches active learnings, and formats them into the prompt section injected for a turn.

nodes.name: schedule_touch_recall
nodes.summary: Schedules a background, non-blocking touch_recall update for the set of learning IDs that were just surfaced.
